findings.summary: gateScopeRefusesAnythingShortOfAQuarantine and gateScopeIgnoresIgnoreFilesThatAreNotThisRepositorys call Files.createTempDirectory("fresh") directly instead of @TempDir. Measured: this JVM's java.io.tmpdir is /tmp (no Gradle/JUnit config in this repo redirects it to build/tmp), so both this call and the pre-existing @TempDir usage in the same file resolve to the system temp directory, contrary to testing.md rule 17 ("Scratch under build/tmp, never the system temp directory").
findings.failure_scenario: Not a mutation-survival risk -- it does not weaken what the test constrains. It is a standards violation worth naming because these two methods are new in this diff and manage their own try/finally rm -rf, which @TempDir would give for free; rule 17 has no wired script yet (a preference per AGENTS.md), and the same gap already exists in harnessTestsCreatesItsLogDirectoryBeforeRedirecting from M0.29, so this is not a regression introduced by this commit, just an opportunity not taken.
